questions.stem: What is the term used for the male gametophyte in gymnosperms?
questions.solution: The male gametophyte in gymnosperms is referred to as a pollen grain because it contains the male reproductive cells. Spores are reproductive units produced by sporangia, zygote is the result of fertilization, and sporangium is the structure that produces spores.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a function of pyrenoids in green algae?

questions.stem: Which of the following is a common characteristic of liverworts and mosses?
choices: They have a dominant sporophyte phase
They reproduce sexually through spores only
They have a thalloid plant body
questions.solution: Liverworts and mosses both have a thalloid plant body, which means their bodies are flat and lack distinct roots, stems, or leaves. Vascular tissues are absent in both, and their life cycle is dominated by the gametophyte phase, not the sporophyte. They also reproduce through both sexual and asexual methods, not exclusively through spores.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a characteristic of brown algae that differentiates them from red algae?
choices: They have a cellulosic wall covered with a gelatinous coating of algin
They store food as floridean starch
They reproduce sexually by non-motile gametes
They have a red pigment called r-phycoerythrin

questions.stem: What is the main plant body of bryophytes called?
questions.solution: The main plant body of bryophytes is the gametophyte, which is the dominant and visible stage in their life cycle. The sporophyte is a dependent structure that grows on the gametophyte and is not the main body. The zygote is a single cell formed by the fusion of gametes, and the archegonium is a structure that produces the egg, neither of which constitutes the main plant body.

questions.stem: If a student observes a green, filamentous organism in a pond that can reproduce by fragmentation, which group is it most likely to belong to?

questions.stem: In which of the following groups are archegonia found?
questions.solution: Archegonia are reproductive structures found in certain plant groups that produce eggs. mr.solution: लाल शैवालांमध्ये लाल रंगद्रव्य आर-फायकोएरिथ्रिन असतो आणि खाद्य पदार्थ फ्लोरिडियन स्टार्च म्हणून साठवला जातो, जे वर्णन केलेल्या वैशिष्ट्यांशी जुळते. हिरव्या शैवालांमध्ये हे रंगद्रव्य नसते आणि ते सामान्यतः स्टार्च म्हणून खाद्य पदार्थ साठवतात, फ्लोरिडियन स्टार्च म्हणून नाही. बॅग शैवालांमध्ये फूक्सोएंथिन असे वेगळे रंगद्रव्य असतात आणि ते फ्लोरिडियन स्टार्च म्हणून खाद्य पदार्थ साठवत नाहीत. ब्रायोफाईट, जे भूमीवरील वनस्पती आहेत, त्यांनी स्टार्च म्हणून खाद्य पदार्थ साठवला जातो, फ्लोरिडियन स्टार्च म्हणून नाही. म्हणून, वनस्पती सर्वात जास्त शक्यतो लाल शैवाल असेल.
